name: Western Wall
description: The holiest site in Judaism, a 2,000-year-old limestone retaining wall in Jerusalem's Old City where millions come to pray.

name: Masada
description: An ancient fortress atop a sheer desert plateau overlooking the Dead Sea, site of the last Jewish stand against Rome in 73 CE.

name: Dead Sea Shore
description: The shores of the world's saltiest natural lake, located at the lowest point on Earth at 430 m below sea level, famous for its buoyant waters.

name: Dome of the Rock
description: A 7th-century Islamic shrine on the Temple Mount in Jerusalem, recognized by its stunning golden dome and intricate mosaics.

name: Baha'i Gardens Haifa
description: Nineteen terraced gardens cascading down the slopes of Mount Carmel in Haifa, surrounding the gilded shrine of the Báb.

name: Caesarea
description: An ancient port city built by Herod the Great featuring a well-preserved Roman amphitheater, aqueduct, and harbor ruins along the Mediterranean coast.

name: Acre Old City
description: A UNESCO World Heritage walled city with Crusader-era halls, Ottoman bazaars, and a dramatic sea fortress on the northern coast.

name: Yad Vashem
description: Israel's official memorial to the six million Jewish victims of the Holocaust, set on the Mount of Remembrance in Jerusalem.

name: Timna Park
description: A geological reserve in the southern Negev featuring dramatic red sandstone formations, ancient Egyptian temples, and copper mines over 6,000 years old.

name: Tel Megiddo
description: An archaeological site in the Jezreel Valley preserving 26 layers of ancient civilizations, including Canaanite temples and Israelite palaces, linked to the biblical Armageddon.
